Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: estimates/response-action-evidence-v1 aef31a29 remains unqualified for current main. InferenceStatusScope and InferenceStatusCode are still absent from current modules, so the historical integration prerequisite has not been satisfied by consolidation.

Fresh context: Yes: retained candidate / re-port.

Next action: Re-port the bounded source/model/action/refusal contract to current first-level and estimate evidence, explicitly adjudicating the missing status abstraction. Requalify exact mismatches and independent positive controls on JVM/JS before consumer admission; do not merge the 65-commit alternate line wholesale.

Evidence: current modules source search; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; branch disposition.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Consumer requirement from PLS Neuro bd-01M1TDZ67J46EQSSBT9VB8MR01.

Difficulty / intended model: astra — very high scientific contract and cross-provider design; any implementation must preserve real-data qualification boundaries.

Current ScalaFIM first-level products retain structural response readouts, compiled designs, fit/preparation/run-combination receipts, and coefficient covariance per voxel. They do not expose a source-bound joint spatial/temporal response-distribution or noise-model contract that can establish whether a complete condition-by-response map is invariant under a specified condition action. Per-voxel covariance and fitted values must not be promoted to that proof.

Scope:
- Design a general provider-owned, versioned contract for conditional response-distribution/noise evidence and permitted actions, linked to exact selected structural readouts, first-level design, preparation, run combination, feature identity, and model assumptions.
- Make unavailable evidence explicit and fail closed. Distinguish a declared scientific model from evidence inferred from fitted coefficients.
- Support a factorized proof where appropriate without requiring consumers to construct a voxel-squared covariance matrix.
- Preserve provider-neutral ownership. This is not a request for a PLS-specific covariance engine or a blanket condition-permutation method.

Acceptance:
- Public API and provenance encoding identify the source/model/action and its scope or refusal.
- Native tests cover unavailable evidence, source/model mismatch, action mismatch, and at least one independently checked positive contract only if its declared assumptions are scientifically explicit.
- Required JVM/Scala.js/provider consumer evidence follows ScalaFIM policy.
- A PLS Neuro adoption remains a separate consumer/calibration ticket; do not use a cross-store blocker edge.

Evidence: PLS Neuro has a positive balanced-FIR marginal-covariance control, unequal-design and AR counterexamples, and an exact spatial-joint covariance counterexample. Its new source-bound boundary refuses all observed condition actions until this provider contract and independent calibration exist.
